text:
anita: Heads up — staging alert flagged by vuln scanner (glibc-ish stack). We saw a failure when running the signed base image in the runtime smoke tests. Need a quick coordinated plan: RBAC for signer, KMS access for a dry-run re-sign, and audit log capture for postmortem. :warning:
kevin: on it, can you paste the scanner output?
jordan: paging in sec oncall. Are we blocking prod or just staging?
anita: staging only for now but failing CI gates. sample from scanner: `glibc CVE-YYYY-XXXX: recommended update to 2.3.4`. Also runtime logs had cosign verify errors: `verification failed: no matching signature`.
maria: cosign error suggests signer role couldn't fetch keywrap from KMS; might be RBAC change rolled yesterday. I can check KMS bindings.
kevin: quick check: who has cosign signer principal? I think `svc-image-signer@redwood` and `svc-build-runner`?
jordan: svc-image-signer role was tightened in PR #4122 yesterday (removed some broad projects). That may be the pulse.
ops-oncall: deploy-bot reports a failed canary deploy earlier: "deploy-bot: canary failed: image verification error"
deploy-bot: BACKOFF: image verification failed during startup (exit 1) — trace: /var/log/containers/image-verify.log
anita: OK. Immediate plan: 1) confirm KMS IAM binding for signer principal, 2) re-run cosign verify with debug, 3) if KMS rotation is blocking, provide escape hatch to allow previously signed image via temporary policy, 4) capture audit logs and preserve for IR. Anyone volunteer to own 1 & 2?
maria: I'll own KMS IAM check and post the bindings. Expect 10–15m.
kevin: I'll re-run cosign from my workstation against the failing digest and paste full debug output. Command I'll run:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 COSIGN_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=... cosign verify --key kms://gcp-kms/projects/../cryptoKeys/signer-key --debug gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:abcd1234
```
kevin: Also check `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ...` to see if `serviceAccount:svc-image-signer@…` has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` or `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` (depending on KMS).
jordan: For the escape hatch: ops can add a temporary admission controller exception that skips `cosign` check for `image: gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:abcd1234` only, and only for staging. We need explicit approval and an audit trail.
ops-oncall: We can implement an admit exception for a specific image digest via configmap TTL, but I'll need approval from sec lead and an ops lead. This will be time-limited and logged.
anita: Good. Also: capture Cloud Audit logs (KMS: AsymmetricSign/AsymmetricDecrypt calls) and GCR access logs. Tag them to the incident ticket: INC-2026.
maria: Update: signer principal is present but bound only to `projects/restricted-builds`; the signer service is trying to use `projects/shared-builds`. So it's a binding namespace mismatch.
kevin: That explains it. Quick fix options: add a project-level binding for `svc-image-signer` to the `shared-builds` cryptoKey, or push a datastore remap for signer to use the restricted project (more invasive).
jordan: Which is lower blast radius?
ops-oncall: Adding the binding in the target KMS key IAM is smallest blast radius. I'll prep the IAM change, but need sec approval and an audit annotation.
anita: Sec approval: +1 from me for a targeted KMS binding change to the one key used by the signer. Make sure we add a justification string and expire the binding in 24h.
maria: I'll add the binding and then attempt a re-sign dry-run. Post-binding I'll run: `cosign verify --key kkms://... --debug ...` and attach output.
kevin: After binding is live, if verify succeeds we can requeue the failing pipeline. If not, use the escape hatch to skip verification for that digest in staging only.
ops-oncall: IAM change done (will annotate in audit). Patch applied: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:svc-image-signer@redwood --role=roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier --condition=None --quiet` — note exact command in the runbook.
maria: Re-run verify: success. `verification passed for sha256:abcd1234`
deploy-bot: canary re-run queued.
anita: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) Short postmortem doc: why PR #4122 removed binding and why our svc discovery used the other project. 2) Add an automated check during PRs that touches signer RBAC to surface cross-project KMS bindings.
jordan: (typo) I'll take the postmortem writeup and the PR for the PR gate.
kevin: Also recommend we put a `kms-key` annotation on images at build time so it's easier to map signer->key.
anita: Thanks everyone. I'll open INC-2026 and link logs. Closing thread when postmortem draft is up. :v:
